photo.caption: The battle of Wadi al-Khazandar in 1299, depicting Mongol archers and Mamluk cavalry. During that time many Mamluk soldiers originated from the Balkan and Black Sea slave trades.
photo.description: The Battle of Wadi al-Khazandar (Battle of Homs) of 1299 (14th-century miniature) This is an early depiction of a "star and crescent" flag. It is important to note that various combinations of stars and crescents are shown in this manuscripts, and they are not consistently attributed to a particular faction (e.g. the Crusaders have a crescent flag on fol. 19v and a star flag on fol. 9v, and the Mongols have a star and crescent on fol. 22rv -- a secondary source is needed for a coherent discussion).
